title: Aftermath and Postcards
author: Rosalind Pemberton
blurb: Coral Nystrom, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
